findings: Failure at t=5s and recovery at t=10s (probe interval 1s) reproduced the identical 3-transition state sequence across all 20 runs: UNHEALTHY@6000ms, RECOVERING@10000ms, HEALTHY@11000ms. health.Registry required no modification -- only its probe-scheduling mechanism (a real ticker + real HTTP in health.Checker) was replaced with a virtual Ticker feeding it a ground-truth schedule instead of a live network probe.
